He would only direct two more films, the second of which, "Hi, Gaucho! ", he would also write the story for.

She took part in the productions of the silent film era and starred in over thirty films.  Between the years of 1916 and 1919, Wilson was credited for writing two films and directing eleven films.  She was best known in the genres of dramas and comedy dramas.
